commit.description: Bump version, update changelog, commit all changes, and push to GitHub
commit.template:
Increment the version, update CHANGELOG.md, then stage, commit, and push. Steps:
1. Read CHANGELOG.md, get today's date with PowerShell: Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd'
2. Read telegram_listener.py, find the current version (pattern: vDD.DD in the banner)
3. Parse vMAJOR.MINOR, increment MINOR by 1, form new version string (e.g., v0.13 → v0.14)
4. Replace the old version with the new version in telegram_listener.py using edit tool
5. Prepend a new entry to CHANGELOG.md right after the title line (# Changelog — TelBot):
   ## vX.YY — YYYY-MM-DD
   - <USER_MESSAGE>
   (with a blank line before the next version section)
6. Stage all files: git add -A
7. Commit: git commit -m "vX.YY: <USER_MESSAGE>"
8. Push to origin master: git push
9. Report the new version number to the user.
IMPORTANT: The user provides the commit message. Use that as both the commit message AND the changelog entry line. Do NOT use --tags (TelBot doesn't use git tags). Bump version and update changelog BEFORE staging.
